description: Tiny scorecard registry for wiring and format smoke checks.

scorecards.description: Minimal promotion gate: require probe + metamorphic suites to pass, and fail on snapshot hash mismatch.

card.intent: Provide a single PASS/FAIL banner over the smoke probe + metamorphic suites.
non_goals: Not a full Golden Rule scorecard; this is only a wiring/gating example.
known_risks: Can be passed while still failing on richer probes/holdouts; use as a smoke gate only.
appropriate_contexts: local drift diagnosis after small changes
